# TheHumanInTheLoop Marketplace

> Public catalog of Claude Code and Codex plugins created by Mauricio Perera.

## Purpose

This marketplace publishes reusable Claude Code and Codex plugins, shared skills, workflows, and deterministic validators. It is designed for human-reviewed AI-assisted work.

Canonical categories: Content & Editorial; Design Systems; Marketplace & Quality; Developer Tools; Accessibility & UX; Security & Privacy; Research & Evidence; AI & Prompt Engineering.

## Plugin catalog

### Auditor SEO/GEO 2026 (`linter-seo-geo-2026`)

- Description: Content validator for search engines and generative engines with hybrid SEO and GEO pre-publication checks.
- Version: 0.1.0
- Category: Productivity
- Author: Mauricio Perera
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/linter-seo-geo-2026
- Claude marketplace manifest: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/blob/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json
- Codex marketplace manifest: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/blob/main/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json

### Marketplace Validator (`marketplace-validator`)

- Description: Validates Claude Code and Codex marketplace manifests, plugin paths, and catalog synchronization.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/marketplace-validator

### Design System Auditor (`design-system-auditor`)

- Description: Generates and validates DESIGN.md, design-system.json, tokens, components, and hard contracts.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/design-system-auditor

### Content Fact Checker (`content-fact-checker`)

- Description: Detects verifiable claims and requires named sources, dates, links, and attributions.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/content-fact-checker

### Repo Quality Gate (`repo-quality-gate`)

- Description: Reviews repositories before commits, pull requests, releases, or deployments.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/repo-quality-gate

### Technical Docs Linter (`technical-docs-linter`)

- Description: Checks README files, API documentation, examples, commands, and links.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/technical-docs-linter

### Accessibility Auditor (`accessibility-auditor`)

- Description: Audits HTML, ARIA, accessible names, forms, contrast, and keyboard behavior.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/accessibility-auditor

### Privacy Risk Auditor (`privacy-risk-auditor`)

- Description: Detects PII, secrets, credentials, and privacy risks before sharing or deploying a repository.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/privacy-risk-auditor

### Release Readiness (`release-readiness`)

- Description: Checks versioning, changelog, license, README, tests, and CI evidence before a release.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/release-readiness

### Prompt Contract Linter (`prompt-contract-linter`)

- Description: Validates prompt objectives, inputs, outputs, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/prompt-contract-linter

### Research Evidence Builder (`research-evidence-builder`)

- Description: Builds research reports and evidence matrices with sources, dates, and attribution.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/research-evidence-builder

### Brand Voice Validator (`brand-voice-validator`)

- Description: Validates tone, vocabulary, claims, clarity, and editorial consistency.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/brand-voice-validator

### API Contract Linter (`api-contract-linter`)

- Description: Audits OpenAPI contracts, paths, operations, responses, and examples.
- Source: https://github.com/MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex/tree/main/plugins/api-contract-linter

## Installation

In Claude Code, add `MauricioPerera/thehumanintheloop-marketplace-codex` and install `linter-seo-geo-2026@thehumanintheloop-marketplace-claude`. In Codex, register the `.agents/plugins` marketplace and install `linter-seo-geo-2026`. Both platforms consume the same plugin directory and shared skills.
